notes: Corded 4-1/2 in (115 mm) angle grinder with a two-stage AC/DC paddle switch, rated 7.5 A at 120 V. Part numbers are those in Makita's 2008 9557PB parts list, which tags many rows with other model codes (9557NB, 9553NB, 9554NB); the 2019 9557NB list adds a few notes, so check numbers against your own motor before buying parts.

gaps: No-load speed: the catalogue gives 10,000 rpm; some retail listings and iFixit give 11,000 rpm (not cited), so the catalogue figure is used.
Only in the 2019 9557NB list, so not claimed for the 9557PB: machined bevel gears 227541-3 and 227542-1, and switch 650579-7.
Brush set: the 2019 NB list gives 195001-2 for CB-325 (not claimed); the 2008 PB list gives 194074-2, which is used.
Cord set: the 2019 NB list gives cord 664895-1 (2P-18-4.0M SJ) and strain relief 687123-7 (not claimed); the 2008 PB list gives 664891-9 and 687169-3, which are used.
The 2008 list prints three part numbers for the 629LLB bearing position and two for the 37-tooth bevel gear; all are given as printed.
The 2008 list's quantity column does not line up with its rows, so quantities were not checked against it.
No thyristor or other speed controller is claimed.
Airgas, fix.com, ereplacementparts and Walmart pages could not be read (HTTP 403, header error, bot check); none of their claims are used.
method: Makita General Catalogue 2014, flipbook page 119 (printed page 117) on makita.ca: the 9557PB/9557PBK entry (7.5 A at 120 V, 10,000 rpm, two-stage AC/DC paddle switch, standard equipment); the page was also rendered from Makita's per-page PDF to confirm which card each figure sits on.
Makita parts breakdown 9557NB, updated 20/03/2019 (makita.ca PDF, pages 1-4 read with the pdf tool): sibling model, used for the notes on parts included in the armature and for the variants it lists.
Makita 9557pb parts breakdown, page 2 of 3, dated 2/8/2008, on ManualsLib (third-party host): columns come out separately, so rows were matched by position (60 rows each; four reads agreed).
Row matching was cross-checked against the catalogue: wheel cover, inner flange and lock nut numbers sit in the rows the position match gives.
Makita owner's manual for 9556PB/9557PB/9558PB on makita.ca returned HTTP 404; a Makita Hong Kong manual in the search results is for the 9557HP, a different model, and is not used.

comps.spec: Motor of the AC/DC two-stage paddle switch grinder; the catalogue lists the tool at 7.5 A at 120 V and 10,000 rpm no load (the amps are the tool's rating, not a motor-only figure)
Armature assembly 115 V, Makita part 515611-3, in the 2008 9557PB list (tagged 9557NB); the 2019 9557NB list shows bearing 607LLB, an insulation washer and fan 56 as included with it
Field 115 V, Makita part 621706-3, in the 2008 9557PB list (tagged 9557NB) and the 2019 9557NB list
Carbon brush CB-325, part 194074-2, and brush holder 643760-7, both in the 2008 9557PB list
Switch 650561-6 (tagged 9557NB), switch lever assembly 154583-3 and lock-on button 418842-2 (both tagged 9557PB), all in the 2008 9557PB list

Spiral bevel gears in the 2008 9557PB list: 10-tooth gear 227464-5 and 37-tooth gear 227505-7 (tagged 9557PB; 227465-3 is also listed for the 37-tooth position); the 2019 9557NB list shows both as sintered
Spindle, Makita part 324474-4, in the 2008 9557PB list and the 2019 9557NB list
Ball bearing 607LLB, part 210034-7, in the 2008 9557PB list; the 2019 9557NB list shows it as included with the armature assembly
Ball bearing 629LLB, part 210042-8; the 2008 9557PB list prints three part numbers for this position (210042-8, 210053-3, 210071-1) and the 2019 9557NB list gives 210042-8 as its Type 3
Ball bearing 696ZZ, part 210033-9, in the 2008 9557PB list and the 2019 9557NB list
Ball bearing 6201DDW, part 211129-9, in the 2008 9557PB list and the 2019 9557NB list
Fan 56, part 240076-7, in the 2008 9557PB list; the 2019 9557NB list shows it as included with the armature assembly
Wheel cover assembly, part 125267-0, tagged 9557PB in the 2008 list and given as the wheel cover in the catalogue's 9557PB standard equipment
Power cord, Makita part 664891-9 (printed as CORD, no model tag), with cord guard 682559-5 and strain relief 687169-3, all in the 2008 9557PB list
